schema: Troll-E collectibles: the asset maker's collect catalog (glb2-glb4) plus the game's rules in each item's "game" (how a01 gets it, its body, what it weighs in the bin)
credit: 3D assets: NVIDIA SimReady Assets (CC BY 4.0), modified: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/simready-assets

diesel_can.name: Viscous Ember
diesel_can.hint: Small fires sleep in black tins. Forty of them dream of hands.
diesel_can.function: Fuel for the Roentgen Furnace and Salamander Lung; 40 feed the Tetrabrachion. Leaks a slick when the cap pops.

fuel_jug.name: Hydra Flask
fuel_jug.hint: Thick blood for machines that bend.
fuel_jug.function: Input: Cadmium Leachfilter, Somnus Bellows, Contrast Syringe.

soda_can.name: Sweet Cradle
soda_can.hint: Drink the sweetness, keep the tin.
soda_can.function: Heliostat Rail (with a solar panel); 20 crushed feed the Roentgen Furnace.

tin_can.name: Tomato Reliquary
tin_can.hint: Empty saints still ring when struck.

water_bottle.name: Clear Vessel
water_bottle.hint: It held clean water once. Remember that.

beer_bottle.name: Green Throat
beer_bottle.hint: Six green throats sing one straight note.

chips_bag.name: Crinkle Ghost
chips_bag.hint: Every wrapper remembers being a shape.

cardboard_box.name: Hollow Cube
cardboard_box.hint: Big and empty, like most promises.

car_battery.name: Lead Heart
car_battery.hint: Heavy hearts still beat if you ask nicely.
car_battery.function: +25% charge on pickup; input for many machines.

drum_rusty.name: Rust Bell
drum_rusty.hint: Ring it and the dark listens.
drum_rusty.function: 50 gal barrel for the Tetrabrachion, Roentgen Furnace, Salamander Lung; burning barrel at night.

solar_panel.name: Daylight Leaf
solar_panel.hint: They were made by the thousand and grow old by the hour.
solar_panel.function: Mount on the bin (8 slots) via the Heliostat Rail; charges only in daylight.
solar_panel.credit: NVIDIA SimReady Assets (CC BY 4.0), modified; procedural parts

car_frame.name: Iron Ribcage
car_frame.hint: A body without a heart is still a body.

vending_machine.name: Glass Larder
vending_machine.hint: It still hums a little at night.

pallet_jack.name: Fork Mule
pallet_jack.hint: Two tines that carried the world.

forklift.name: Old Lifter
forklift.hint: The old lifter's heart still wants to run downhill.

ibc_tank.name: Caged Rain
ibc_tank.hint: A cage built to hold water, not birds.
ibc_tank.function: Lumen Vigil, Cadmium Leachfilter input; shelter water store.

pallet_rack.name: Ladder of Shelves
pallet_rack.hint: Climb it and nothing climbs back.
pallet_rack.function: Skiagraph Pillar, Photon Altar input; shelter frame.

wheelbarrow.name: One-Wheel Ox
wheelbarrow.function: Shelter building (moves 4 items at once - future).

leech_husk.name: Leech Husk
leech_husk.real: dead energy leech (rearranged hose, EV plug, jumper clamps, bulbs)
leech_husk.hint: Wear the mouth of the thing that fed on you.
leech_husk.function: Leech Collar input; jaws = jumper clamps (Lazarus Clamps).
leech_husk.credit: NVIDIA SimReady Assets (CC BY 4.0), modified; procedural parts

wrench.name: Iron Jaw
wrench.hint: It only knows how to turn what it is told to.

battery_9v.name: Square Spark
battery_9v.hint: Touch it to your tongue. It still bites.
battery_9v.function: +2% charge on pickup; Tetrabrachion, Skiagraph Pillar, Echo Psalter, Lazarus Clamps, Charge Oracle, Warmth Eye.

hydraulic_hose.name: Black Vein
hydraulic_hose.function: Dioscuri Rig, Cadmium Leachfilter, Somnus Bellows, Iron Breath, Contrast Syringe.

light_bulb.name: Glass Ember
light_bulb.hint: A sun small enough to lose in a pocket.
light_bulb.function: Lumen Vigil (12), Skiagraph Pillar, Warmth Eye, Small Vigil.

fuse.name: Red Sleeper
fuse.hint: It dies so the rest can live.
fuse.function: Lumen Vigil, Ley Junction (8), Leech Collar; the Matter Loom prints more.

alternator.name: Spinning Lung
alternator.hint: Turn it and it remembers lightning.

copper_cable.name: Copper Nerve
copper_cable.hint: The street's nerves, pulled out by the root.
copper_cable.function: Roentgen Furnace (10), Skiagraph Pillar, Echo Psalter, Arc Forge, Ley Junction, Leech Collar.

cctv_dome.name: Glass Eye
cctv_dome.hint: It watched everything and saved nothing.

office_monitor.name: Dead Window
office_monitor.hint: Someone logged in. Nobody logged out.

anesthesia_mask.name: Sleep Cup
anesthesia_mask.hint: Breathe in. Count back from ten.

shop_fan.name: Wind Flower
shop_fan.hint: It turned its face to everyone.

multimeter_clamp.name: Truth Claw
multimeter_clamp.hint: Close it round a wire and the wire confesses.

iv_pole.name: Drip Tree
iv_pole.hint: A tree that grew medicine instead of leaves.

oilfilter_pliers.name: Grip Mother
oilfilter_pliers.hint: Every claw begins as a pair of hands.
oilfilter_pliers.function: Dioscuri Rig (2). The same pliers are the claw's fingers.

jumper_clamps.name: Twin Teeth
jumper_clamps.hint: Teeth taken from what bit you will bite back once.
jumper_clamps.function: Lazarus Clamps (2), Charge Oracle. Dead leeches drop them.

work_light.name: Pocket Noon
work_light.hint: Hold the dark back by an arm's length.
work_light.function: Placeable warm light (about 6 m). Lets you see leeches; it does not stop them (only UV does).

inspection_lamp.name: Leash Light
inspection_lamp.hint: Light on a leash. It never strays far from the socket.
inspection_lamp.function: Hangs from the bin rim: a small light that travels with Troll-E.

strip_light.name: Bench Halo
strip_light.hint: A thin line between you and the night.
strip_light.function: Shelter light (under shelves, over the bench).

alarm_beacon.name: Red Herald
alarm_beacon.function: Shelter alarm: spins red when the Warmth Eye sees leeches.

tea_candles.name: Last Embers
tea_candles.function: Tiny warm light that costs no charge.

wire_wall.name: Cage Leaf
wire_wall.hint: A wall you can see through keeps out everything but the view.

accordion_gate.name: Folding Mouth
accordion_gate.function: Shelter door (Cage Hive; two for the bunker).

door.note: one half of barrier_gate_safety_a02 (the source is two 3 m sections); place two mirrored for a 6 m opening

roof_pallet.name: Blue Shingle
roof_pallet.hint: It carried the world's boxes. Now it carries the rain.
roof_pallet.function: Roof tiles: a patch roof on the first night, the Rack Fort roof (16).

roof_slab.name: Sky Lid
roof_slab.hint: Put a lid on the sky.

storage_shelf.name: Patient Shelf
storage_shelf.hint: It waits. It is good at waiting.

coolant_tank.name: Steel Cistern
coolant_tank.hint: Clean water, if you can make it clean.
coolant_tank.function: Shelter coolant store (fed by the Cadmium Leachfilter).

hoop_guard.name: Stub Sentry
hoop_guard.hint: It stands where it is told and never sleeps.

bedding.name: Soft Heap
bedding.hint: Robots do not sleep. It is nice to pretend.

plywood_crate.name: Hollow Ark
plywood_crate.hint: Nailed shut by someone who planned to come back.

scaffold.name: Iron Ladder Tower
scaffold.hint: Climb it and the map grows.

guard_panel.name: Mesh Scale
guard_panel.hint: Scales for a building that wants armour.

workbench.name: Maker's Altar
workbench.hint: Everything here began on a table.

r01_tetrabrachion.name: Tetrabrachion
r01_tetrabrachion.hint: Four hands remember what one forgot. Feed them forty small fires.
r01_tetrabrachion.function: Grabber upgrade: four arms replace the claw. Picks up to 4 items per press, lifts drums and car parts the claw cannot, reach +25%.

r02_heliostat_rail.name: Heliostat Rail
r02_heliostat_rail.hint: Drink the sweetness, keep the tin: the sun needs a cradle.
r02_heliostat_rail.function: Unlocks one solar mount slot on the bin (craft up to 8). The panel itself is consumed into the rail.

r03_dioscuri_rig.name: Dioscuri Rig
r03_dioscuri_rig.hint: Two brothers, one heartbeat, a screen that watches both.
r03_dioscuri_rig.function: Second arm pair on the back of the bin: carry while grabbing, double pickup speed.

r04_lumen_vigil.name: Lumen Vigil
r04_lumen_vigil.hint: What drinks the dark cannot drink this light.
r04_lumen_vigil.function: Wandering UV-C sentry around the shelter. Leeches will not cross its 8 m radius for 3 nights.

r05_mole_courier.name: Mole Courier
r05_mole_courier.hint: Lay a fork on its back and give it eyes; it will dig for you.
r05_mole_courier.function: Autonomous scout: fetches one marked item per day and maps cadmium puddles on the minimap.

r06_roentgen_furnace.name: Roentgen Furnace
r06_roentgen_furnace.hint: Wind the copper, crush the silver tins, and the drum will hum through midnight.
r06_roentgen_furnace.function: Shelter generator: turns diesel cans into charge at night (1 can = 10% bin battery).

r07_skiagraph_pillar.name: Skiagraph Pillar
r07_skiagraph_pillar.hint: Stand the bones upright and walls become rumours.
r07_skiagraph_pillar.function: Needs a Roentgen Furnace nearby. Reveals hidden or buried supplies through walls within 15 m for 20 s.

r08_coherent_lance.name: Coherent Lance
r08_coherent_lance.hint: Six green throats sing one straight note.
r08_coherent_lance.function: Cuts barricades and fences (opens shortcuts) and burns a latched leech off in 2 s.

r09_echo_psalter.name: Echo Psalter
r09_echo_psalter.hint: Listen to the mud. It is full of things that were thrown away.
r09_echo_psalter.function: Pings buried items in mud and puddles within 10 m.

r10_cadmium_leachfilter.name: Cadmium Leachfilter
r10_cadmium_leachfilter.hint: The yellow water is sick. Give it new kidneys.
r10_cadmium_leachfilter.function: Purifies cadmium puddle water into coolant (consumable: repairs aged panels, cools motors for faster driving).

r11_somnus_bellows.name: Somnus Bellows
r11_somnus_bellows.hint: Even hunger sleeps if you breathe for it.
r11_somnus_bellows.function: Releases a sleep cloud at the shelter door: leeches inside 6 m stay dormant for one night.

r12_iron_breath.name: Iron Breath
r12_iron_breath.hint: A shelter that cannot breathe will rust in its sleep.
r12_iron_breath.function: Shelter air scrubber: no overnight corrosion, items stored inside keep full value.

r13_lazarus_clamps.name: Lazarus Clamps
r13_lazarus_clamps.hint: Teeth taken from what bit you will bite back once.
r13_lazarus_clamps.function: One-shot revive at 0% battery (restores 25%) and shocks a latched leech off.

r14_matter_loom.name: Matter Loom
r14_matter_loom.hint: Every wrapper remembers being a shape.
r14_matter_loom.function: Shelter crafting station: unlocks tier-2 recipes and prints fuses and bolts from plastic trash.

r15_arc_forge.name: Arc Forge
r15_arc_forge.hint: Marry the rust to the lightning and it will stand up.
r15_arc_forge.function: Builds and upgrades shelter walls, roof and doors from scrap.

r16_ley_junction.name: Ley Junction
r16_ley_junction.hint: Where the street's veins meet, store the noon for midnight.
r16_ley_junction.function: Shelter power hub: night storage and 2 extra panel circuits. Daylight only charges it; it carries Troll-E through the night.

r17_charge_oracle.name: Charge Oracle
r17_charge_oracle.hint: Ask the cell how long it has. It will not lie to this.
r17_charge_oracle.function: Shows true charge on found batteries and each solar panel's age tier and efficiency.

r18_photon_altar.name: Photon Altar
r18_photon_altar.hint: Lay the tired suns flat and they remember noon.
r18_photon_altar.function: Restores one aged panel one tier per day (ruined to aged to new), at the cost of the four sacrificed panels.

r19_salamander_lung.name: Salamander Lung
r19_salamander_lung.hint: Cold batteries bleed faster. Give the night a fever.
r19_salamander_lung.function: Shelter heater: burns diesel at night, so night drain is 30% lower while docked.

r20_dynamo_heart.name: Dynamo Heart
r20_dynamo_heart.hint: The old lifter's heart still wants to run downhill.
r20_dynamo_heart.function: Drive upgrade: +25% top speed and regenerative braking on slopes.

r21_leech_collar.name: Leech Collar
r21_leech_collar.hint: Wear the mouth of the thing that fed on you.
r21_leech_collar.function: Passive: the first leech each night that latches on is zapped off automatically.

r22_contrast_syringe.name: Contrast Syringe
r22_contrast_syringe.hint: Dye the blood of the machine and it will run like a rumour.
r22_contrast_syringe.function: Consumable overdrive: 60 s at double speed with double drain.

r23_warmth_eye.name: Warmth Eye
r23_warmth_eye.hint: They are cold. Watch for the holes in the heat.
r23_warmth_eye.function: Shelter sensor: warns 30 s before leeches approach.

r24_small_vigil.name: Small Vigil
r24_small_vigil.hint: A pocket of noon you can set down in the mud.
r24_small_vigil.function: Placeable UV lamp: leech-free 4 m radius for one night.

rusty_beam.name: Rust Spine
rusty_beam.hint: What held the roof up still remembers the weight.

dock_charger.name: Glass Cradle
dock_charger.hint: Every shelter starts where something can sleep and wake up full.
dock_charger.function: The shelter's charger: a01 parks on its pad overnight.

edge_rail.name: Dock Jaw
edge_rail.hint: A gate that once kept forklifts from the edge.

led_hexgrid.name: Honeycomb Noon
led_hexgrid.hint: Six-sided light, for rooms that hate the dark.

coolant.name: Clear Kidney
coolant.real: coolant, purified from cadmium puddle water
coolant.hint: The sick water, cured, cools what runs hot.
coolant.function: Repairs one aged panel to new and clears every panel's dust; cools the motors (+15 % top speed for 60 s).

warehouse_corner.name: warehouse corner module
warehouse_corner.function: Warehouse-corner bunker module, sunk 1.3 m so its floor meets the ground.

warehouse_bay.name: warehouse centre bay
warehouse_bay.function: Warehouse-corner bunker module, sunk 1.3 m so its floor meets the ground.
